description: This file defines API routes for managing workouts, exercises, templates, programs, and program days in a gym management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, adding, and deleting exercises, templates, programs, and program days, with role-based access control.

methods.name: create_exercise_endpoint
methods.description: Creates a new exercise owned by the trainer.

methods.name: list_exercises_endpoint
methods.description: Lists exercises owned by the authenticated trainer with pagination.

methods.name: create_template_endpoint
methods.description: Creates a workout template owned by the trainer.

methods.name: list_templates_endpoint
methods.description: Lists workout templates owned by the trainer.

methods.name: add_template_exercise_endpoint
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a workout template.

methods.name: delete_template_exercise_endpoint
methods.description: Removes an exercise from a workout template.

methods.name: assign_program_endpoint
methods.description: Creates and assigns a program to a member user.

methods.name: list_my_programs_endpoint
methods.description: Lists programs for the current member.

methods.name: list_programs_for_trainer_endpoint
methods.description: Lists programs created by the trainer for their clients.

methods.name: create_program_day_endpoint
methods.description: Creates a day in a program.

methods.name: list_program_days_endpoint
methods.description: Lists days for a program, accessible by trainer or member.

methods.name: add_program_day_exercise_endpoint
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a specific program day.

methods.name: list_program_day_exercises_endpoint
methods.description: Lists exercises for a program day, with visibility constraints.
